description: What Xodia knows about a project: the Xodia host it lives on (xodiaHost), how its preview runs (preview), framework, styling, CMS, host, editing tier, the branch the workspace has open, whether that branch is view only on the workspace's plan (branchViewOnly), whether the plan includes timeline motion effects (motionTimeline), whether pushing to the user's own Git works on the plan (ownGit: Starter and up; on Free the site goes live with Xodia hosting on a xodia.site address), transferPending when the project is being handed to another workspace and may leave this one soon (the user sends, cancels and accepts transfers in Xodia; there is no tool for them), the plan's page and CMS limits when it has them (planLimits: pagesPerProject, the pages the plan can edit besides the home page, the pages counted so far, cmsCollections and cmsLimits for Xodia collections, otherCollections for Markdown folders, Decap and connected CMSs, and a note to follow), files changed since the last restore point (unsavedFiles), for a site made with Import a website, imported (its IMPORTED.md, source address and how to edit it), and for a project made with Make it fully editable (it turns an imported site into React code), converted (its CONVERTED.md and how to tidy it), and for an imported site, source (where it came from, its stack in short, motion found in its code, and the state, notes and needsUser of Xodia's Tailwind 4 upgrade and import adapter), and serverOff when the app was brought in with its server parts switched off (where the list of those features is and the rule for bringing one back), and lockedPages when the site has pages past the ones the plan can edit (their addresses and own files, the count, and what you may and may not do: they can be read, checked and published, not changed), and database when the site can connect a database: the connected Supabase project (provider, project name, region, status, a note on what to do) and its tables with each field's kind, never keys (list_tables and describe_table say more), and serverTasks when Xodia offers server tasks: whether they are on for the site, each task's address, methods and file, key names the code reads that aren't set (never values), the last build's problems at file:line, calls this month against the plan, resting or stopped, and where the owner sets keys and schedules in Xodia. Call it first on an imported or converted site, and before planning new pages or collections.
name: get_project
title: Get project
